title: workplan_reset input (native surface)
description: Reset a plan to the draft planning state, or regenerate only its Markdown.

id.description: Workplan id; normalized to lowercase [a-z0-9-] (max 80) before use.

preserveNotes.description: Keep notes on a draft reset.

expectedHash.description: stateHash from the latest read; binds the write to that exact state.

x-shiori-rules.native: Native existing-state writes require the current stateHash

x-shiori-core-surface: The standalone CLI/core surface additionally accepts optional 'workspaceRoot' (string); the native surface rejects it as an unrecognized key. The allOf conditions are native-surface rules; the core surface keeps expectedHash optional for legacy direct calls (a concurrent change must still be detected), and uses the 'core' messages in x-shiori-rules.
